messages:
oliver: Heads-up — planning the user_profiles backfill + schema toggle this Wed 02:00 UTC (quiet window). Need confirmations: who is running the migration, who owns smoke, and who will lead rollback?
jena: I can own smoke checks (read/write probes, auth flow, spot sampling).
mika: I’ll run the migration job and watch DB metrics. Confirming the schema change is backcompat? any toggles?
kai: Toggle exists: profiles_v2_enabled (default=false). We’ll dual-write during backfill and flip only after smoke. Canary at 5% for 15m before full flip.
oliver: Rollback criteria proposal: any error rate >0.5% or sustained p99>500ms for 10m triggers rollback. Who will execute?
mika: I’ll coordinate rollback (stop backfill, flip toggle off, and promote snapshot if needed). Requesting a reserved read replica we can promote for rollback tests.
jena: Smoke checklist (short):
```
- healthcheck: /health, /api/v1/profile?id=123
- sign-in flow (create/login/update profile)
- sample read queries from top 10 queries
- background jobs: embeddings & notify sanity
- validate new columns populated for sampled users
```
I'll run these immediately after canary.
oliver: @deploy-bot please reserve the slot and send reminder 1h before.
deploy-bot: Slot reserved: user_profiles backfill — 2026-04-01T02:00:00Z. Reminder scheduled 60m prior.
reza: I’m oncall that window, will monitor alerts and take pager.
oliver: Backfill estimate: ~3h if throttled to 200 QPS. Plan: throttle to keep p95<200ms. Mika — can you add --max-qps=200 and a dynamic throttle knob?
mika: Yep. Will run with --max-qps=200 and a --pause-on-latency=300ms threshold. I’ll post run output/links in thread once started.
oliver: Quick question: are we using a write-fence for this? That would add prep time.
kai: No write-fence. We’ll dual-write both v1/v2 during backfill. That keeps switchover cheap.
jena: Note for rollback: disabling dual-write + stopping backfill will restore prior behavior; confirm deploy windows for next slot if we need re-run.
oliver: Final owners: migration=mika, smoke=jena, oncall=reza, release=kai. I’ll add to calendar and the runbook. If anyone objects to the timing or ownership, flag here.
mika: One more: I’ll need DB client creds with replica promotion rights — cc: @kai to approve.
kai: Approved, will send keys via vault and add to the runbook.
oliver: Thanks everyone — I’ll post final runbook link and add a short preflight checklist 1h before kickoff. :thumbsup:
